meta.title: TAT & Step-Time Enforcement: refused for a user without the Procurement Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and verify that TAT & Step-Time Enforcement is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Procurement Manager in the same tenant and verify that TAT is shown, step durations are enforced, and overdue flags appear.
Compare the non-Procurement Manager and Procurement Manager outcomes, including any RBAC configuration explanation.
